title: systemd Service Generator
description: Generate a systemd unit file — ExecStart, user, restart policy, environment and install target.
howto: Enter the description and ExecStart command.
Set the user, working directory and restart policy.
Add environment variables (one KEY=value per line).
Copy the unit file or download myapp.service.

faqs.a: Save as /etc/systemd/system/<name>.service, then run: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now <name>.

faqs.q: Which restart policy should I use?
faqs.a: on-failure restarts only on crashes; always restarts even after clean exits.
One KEY=value per line — values with spaces are quoted automatically.
WantedBy=multi-user.target makes the service start on boot when enabled.
